key: Prepare Calm, Building, and Combat arrangements of the same piece. Each must last 10 seconds to 15 minutes. Originals are deleted after conversion; keep your own source files.

key: Questions and brainstorming are free. A creation or revision request starts one build of up to 12 building variants. Failed generations return their reservation.

key: Set the goals and your globs get to work. Feed your colony, train your units and explore together.

editor_reason: Warm describes musical timbre; physically hot bells or redundant soft-warm phrasing distract from the sound palette.

key: Usernames can only use letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores (no spaces).
before: صارف نام میں صرف حروف، ہندسے، نقطے، ڈیش اور انڈر اسکور ہو سکتے ہیں (خالی جگہ نہیں)۔
after: صارف نام میں صرف انگریزی حروف (A–Z، a–z)، ہندسے (0–9)، نقطے، ڈیش اور انڈر اسکور ہو سکتے ہیں (خالی جگہ نہیں)۔
editor_reason: Actual registration regex allows ASCII Latin letters and digits only. Unqualified حروف misleadingly permits Urdu characters; pair with the registration hint finding.

before: واپس لیں
after: کالعدم کریں
editor_reason: The same action is translated کالعدم کریں in the leading-space key. Use one term across the same Studio revision controls, including undo revision.

after: ترمیم کالعدم کریں
editor_reason: Align the concrete undo action with leading-space Undo کالعدم کریں; واپس لیں can mean withdrawing a revision rather than reversing it.

key: You can only ban accounts with a lower role.

editor_reason: Make relative permissions explicit; current chat context is correct.

key: Your creation will appear here. You can inspect, edit, compare, and publish saved versions.
before: آپ کی تخلیق یہاں ظاہر ہو گی۔ محفوظ ورژن دیکھ، بدل، موازنہ اور شائع کر سکتے ہیں۔

before: الگ راستے پر گیا

key: Good under {value0}, fair under {value1}, poor from {value2}.

key: The provider outcome needs reconciliation. Your reserved {value0} credits remain held; new requests are paused. Manual editing and export remain available.

editor_reason: روکے رہتے ہیں is an active causative form (remain stopping/holding) without a passive auxiliary; credit holds should be clearly held, not doing the holding.
